description: This file contains unit tests for the Bug module in SuiteCRM, verifying various behaviors such as object construction, query generation, field filling, notifications, and CRUD operations using PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: BugTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Bug module, extending the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase to test functionalities like object creation, query assembly, field population, and notification handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by initializing the current user and configurations before each test.

methods.name: testBug
methods.description: Tests the creation of a Bug bean and verifies core attributes and relationships.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Checks the behavior of getting the bug's summary text with and without a name.

methods.name: testcreate_list_query
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query generated for listing bugs with different parameters.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query generated for exporting bug data.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures that fill_in_additional_list_fields() executes without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Checks that related user names are set correctly from user IDs.

methods.name: testset_release
methods.description: Tests setting release information on the bug object.

methods.name: testset_fixed_in_release
methods.description: Tests setting the fixed-in release information.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Verifies the data returned for list views in the UI.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Checks the correct construction of SQL where clauses based on input.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Verifies that notification emails are populated with correct bug details.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests whether the bean correctly implements specific behaviors like ACL.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests saving a bug record and its deletion behavior.

methods.name: testgetReleaseDropDown
methods.description: Checks that the release dropdown list returns an array.
